description.narrative:
Goals
• Developing an adequate macroeconomic framework for policy formulation and implementation in line with Somalia's IMF program. This framework would aim to include annual quantitative estimates and projections of economic activity, public revenue and expenditure, balance of payments flows, and monetary variables, as well as a medium-term fiscal framework.
• Enhancing the capacity for the production of macroeconomic statistics. The focus will be on improving the production of monetary, fiscal, external sector (balance of payments), as well as national accounts and price data in line with international standards.
• Improving central bank organization and operations. The primary objective is to provide technical input and hands-on training to central bank staff for capacity development in central banking (i.e., establishing and organizing core activities such as monetary and foreign exchange operations, foreign reserves management, accounting, reporting and control, research and statistics, and institutional governance).
• Strengthening financial stability, supervision, and regulation. The objective is to provide the technical input and hands-on training to improve (i) financial sector supervision and regulation, and (ii) policies and institutions related to anti-money laundering and combating financing of terrorism.
• Strengthening public financial management, public debt management, and public investment management. The key goal is to help strengthen PFM reforms to support fiscal stability, accountability and oversight. This includes providing strategic advice and assisting in the coordination of macroeconomic reforms in areas such as budget planning and preparation, expenditure control and cash management, and financial oversight and audit. This also includes supporting the efforts on fiscal federalism to ensure a broader assessment of the country's revenue and expenditure capacity. It would also include helping establish the capacity to manage public investments and building debt management capacity to help the authorities sustain debt sustainability post-HIPC Completion Point. More broadly, this would also include advice on securing fiscal space to support critical interventions in line with the authorities development priorities as outlined in the National Development Plan and to underpin economic resilience (as outlined in the underlying Recovery and Resilience Framework).
• Improving tax and customs policy and administration. The focus will be on operationalizing the recently signed Revenue Law and helping broaden domestic revenue mobilization efforts to the Federal Member States (FMS). This includes enhancing revenue administration and capacity building in the fiscal regimes for the utilization of natural resources.
Objectives and outcomes
Sector: Public Financial Management - Comprehensive, credible, and policy-based budget preparation Outcome: A more comprehensive and unified annual budget is published
- Improved budget execution and control Outcome: Budget execution and controls are strengthened
- Improved coverage and quality of fiscal reporting Outcomes: i) Comprehensiveness, frequency, and quality of fiscal reports is enhanced ii) The chart of accounts and budget classifications are aligned with international standards
Sector: Revenue Administration - Improved customs administration functions Outcome: Customs control during the clearance process more effectively ensures accuracy of declarations
- Strengthened core tax administration functions Outcomes: i) A larger proportion of taxpayers meet their filing obligations as required by law ii) Audit and other verification programs more effectively ensure accuracy of reporting iii) The integrity of the taxpayer base and ledger is strengthened
- Strengthened revenue administration management and governance arrangements Outcome: Support functions enable more effective delivery of strategy and reforms
Sector: Tax Policy - Improved tax and non-tax revenue policy Outcomes: i) Improved structures and capacity related to tax policy advice and analysis, including organization of tax policy units and building tax models or other tools for analysis and revenue forecasting ii) Increased economic efficiency by minimizing the economic distortions imposed by taxes or by using taxes to address externalities or market failures
Sector: Central Bank Operations - Adopt the International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF) of the Institute of Internal Auditors as the central banks risk-based Internal Audit framework Outcome: Diagnostic of critical deficiencies relative to compliance with IPPF completed
- Enhance the central banks decision-making capacity and internal organization Outcome: The central bank has effective decision-making body/bodies
- Strengthen efficient implementation of monetary policy under the existing regime Outcome: The central bank has an operational strategy
Sector: Financial Supervision and Regulation - Develop/strengthen banks regulation and supervision frameworks Outcomes: i) Clear supervisory process to review licensing applications in line with required criteria implemented. ii) Legislation/prudential regulations on capital adequacy developed/strengthened, including maintaining adequate capital structure composed of high capital instruments in line with Basel II/III iii) Legislation/regulations on liquidity developed/strengthened including maintaining adequate liquidity positions to withstand crises and shocks in short-term and to retain stable funding resources to finance their longer-term assets.
- Develop/strengthen regulatory framework and supervisory tools to address specific risks in Islamic banking Outcome: Prudential framework for IIBS developed/strengthened.
- Implement a risk-based supervision (RBS) system and upgrade other supervisory processes Outcome: Supervisors have sufficient capacity to effectively implement risk-based supervision and other supervisory processes
Sector: External Sector statistics - Strengthen compilation and dissemination of external sector statistics Outcomes: i)Source data are adequate for the compilation of these macroeconomic statistics. ii) Staff capacity increased through training, especially on developing source data, compilation methods, and dissemination
Sector: Financial Institutions statistics - Strengthen compilation and dissemination of financial Institutions statistics Outcomes: i) Improved data and metadata accessibility ii) Source data are adequate for the compilation of these macroeconomic statistics
- Strengthen compilation and dissemination of financial soundness indicators Outcome: A new data set has been compiled and disseminated internally and/or to the public
Sector: Government Finance statistics - Strengthen compilation and dissemination of Government Finance Statistics Outcomes: i) Methodological basis for the statistics follows internationally accepted standards, guidelines, or good practices. ii) Staff capacity increased through training, especially on developing source data, compilation methods, and dissemination. iii) Statistical techniques are sound
Sector: Real Sector - National Accounts statistics - Strengthen compilation and dissemination of real sector statistics - national accounts Outcomes: i) A new data set has been compiled and disseminated internally and/or to the public ii) Source data are routinely assessed (for coverage, sample error, response error, and non-sampling error) and assessments are monitored and made available to guide statistical processes iii) Staff capacity increased through training, especially on developing source data, compilation methods, and dissemination

16.6 - Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions at all levels.

16.a - Strengthen relevant national institutions, including through international cooperation, for building capacity at all levels, in particular in developing countries, to prevent violence and combat terrorism and crime.

16.a - Stärka berörda nationella institutioner, bland annat genom internationellt samarbete, i syfte att bygga upp kapacitet på alla nivåer, i synnerhet i utvecklingsländerna, för att förebygga våld och bekämpa terrorism och brottslighet.
17.1 - Strengthen domestic resource mobilization, including through international support to developing countries, to improve domestic capacity for tax and other revenue collection.
17.1 - Stärka den inhemska resursmobiliseringen, inklusive genom internationellt stöd till utvecklingsländerna, för att förbättra den inhemska kapaciteten att ta upp skatter och andra intäkter.

17.9 - Enhance international support for implementing effective and targeted capacity-building in developing countries to support national plans to implement all the Sustainable Development Goals, including through North-South, South-South and triangular cooperation.

17.9 - Öka det internationella stödet för genomförande av effektiv och riktad kapacitetsuppbyggnad i utvecklingsländerna till stöd för nationella planer för att genomföra alla målen för hållbar utveckling, inklusive genom samarbete nord–syd och syd–syd samt trepartssamarbete.
